- **#8841:** Tobias posted this in #central-random on 13 Oct. His message says "Tobias's dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks. I included it because the dealer account seems to have moved to Tobias in the 5 Jan handoff, and I suggested Pree check with him.
- **PD-5302:** Hollis posted this in #central-random on 14 Oct and names Marrow Fieldworks.

I also told Pree I'd left out FR-882 and PD-4821, which belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. I only read sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, her DM with me and the public Moss digests. I didn't use message search.
